title: The Real-life World of Water Margin
synopsis: ”Water Margin”, one of China’s “Four Great Classical Novels”, depicts a peasant rebellion during the waning years of the Northern Song dynasty.

series.title: The Splendor of the Song Dynasty

fullText.simplified:
梁山起义——真实的水浒世界

    说起中国古典小说，大家对《西游记》、《三国演义》和《红楼梦》较为熟悉。不过事实上，中国有“四大名著”的说法。“四大名著”指的是四部优秀的古典长篇小说，代表中国古典小说艺术的最高成就。除了上述三部，还有一部《水浒传》。
    《水浒传》成书于明代初期，现代学界主流观点认为作者是施耐庵。这部小说描写了以宋江为首的108位梁山好汉反抗朝廷、壮大队伍和接受朝廷招安，以及接受招安后为宋朝征战的宏大故事，表达的主题是忠义。《水浒传》情节生动曲折，戏剧冲突尖锐，人物形象鲜明立体，具有极高的文学价值。小说中虽然存在一些神话色彩，例如将108位梁山好汉设定为星宿转世，但本质上这些好汉大多是来自社会中下层的平民英雄，描写的是真实社会。小说呈现的是一个政治腐败、道德崩坏的社会。在这样的背景下，反抗朝廷的梁山好汉并不是反面人物，而是劫富济贫的正义英雄。在“四大名著”中，《水浒传》虽然较为血腥暴力，但其对官场腐败、民不聊生的描写，却真实地反映出古代中国王朝末期的社会状态，因为其改编自北宋末年真实的农民起义事件。
    北宋末年，山东梁山地区爆发了农民起义。当时黄河决口导致土地被淹，无粮可吃的农民只好以捕鱼、挖藕为生。但朝廷不但没有发粮救济，反而要求农民缴纳鱼和藕的税金。于是，当地农民在基层官员宋江的带领下起兵反抗朝廷。虽然起义军只有几千人，但还是给当时的社会造成了一定的影响。三年后，宋江兵败被俘，起义军接受朝廷招安。宋江的结局历史上没有明确的记载。有学者认为他在兵败时被朝廷所杀；也有学者认为他在招安后，与官兵一起征讨其他起义军时被杀；还有学者认为他在征讨其他起义军后离开朝廷，归隐山林了。
    宋江起义是北宋末年农民反抗朝廷的一个缩影。北宋末年，社会贫富差距日益拉大，仅占人口总数不到10%的官僚、地主等特权阶层拥有全国约60%-70%的土地，他们通过各种手段将税收转嫁给失地农民，导致农民生活艰难。另一方面，皇帝纵容官员腐败，加剧了底层农民的生存困境。种种压力之下，农民们选择了反抗，追求新的希望。
    真实的水浒世界也许不像小说中描写的那么理想化，但“官逼民反”的历史规律反映了一个道理：不管是北宋末年，还是其他朝代的末期，底层老百姓的痛苦都是刻骨铭心的。
fullText.traditional:
梁山起義——真實的水滸世界

    說起中國古典小說，大家對《西遊記》、《三國演義》和《紅樓夢》較為熟悉。不過事實上，中國有“四大名著”的說法。“四大名著”指的是四部優秀的古典長篇小說，代表中國古典小說藝術的最高成就。除了上述三部，還有一部《水滸傳》。
    《水滸傳》成書於明代初期，現代學界主流觀點認為作者是施耐庵。這部小說描寫了以宋江為首的108位梁山好漢反抗朝廷、壯大隊伍和接受朝廷招安，以及接受招安後為宋朝征戰的宏大故事，表達的主題是忠義。《水滸傳》情節生動曲折，戲劇衝突尖銳，人物形象鮮明立體，具有極高的文學價值。小說中雖然存在一些神話色彩，例如將108位梁山好漢設定為星宿轉世，但本質上這些好漢大多是來自社會中下層的平民英雄，描寫的是真實社會。小說呈現的是一個政治腐敗、道德崩壞的社會。在這樣的背景下，反抗朝廷的梁山好漢並不是反面人物，而是劫富濟貧的正義英雄。在“四大名著”中，《水滸傳》雖然較為血腥暴力，但其對官場腐敗、民不聊生的描寫，卻真實地反映出古代中國王朝末期的社會狀態，因為其改編自北宋末年真實的農民起義事件。
    北宋末年，山東梁山地區爆發了農民起義。當時黃河決口導致土地被淹，無糧可吃的農民只好以捕魚、挖藕為生。但朝廷不但沒有發糧救濟，反而要求農民繳納魚和藕的稅金。於是，當地農民在基層官員宋江的帶領下起兵反抗朝廷。雖然起義軍只有幾千人，但還是給當時的社會造成了一定的影響。三年後，宋江兵敗被俘，起義軍接受朝廷招安。宋江的結局歷史上沒有明確的記載。有學者認為他在兵敗時被朝廷所殺；也有學者認為他在招安後，與官兵一起征討其他起義軍時被殺；還有學者認為他在征討其他起義軍後離開朝廷，歸隱山林了。
    宋江起義是北宋末年農民反抗朝廷的一個縮影。北宋末年，社會貧富差距日益拉大，僅占人口總數不到10%的官僚、地主等特權階層擁有全國約60%-70%的土地，他們通過各種手段將稅收轉嫁給失地農民，導致農民生活艱難。另一方面，皇帝縱容官員腐敗，加劇了底層農民的生存困境。種種壓力之下，農民們選擇了反抗，追求新的希望。
    真實的水滸世界也許不像小說中描寫的那麼理想化，但“官逼民反”的歷史規律反映了一個道理：不管是北宋末年，還是其他朝代的末期，底層老百姓的痛苦都是刻骨銘心的。

sentences.traditional: 還有學者認為他在征討其他起義軍後離開朝廷，歸隱山林了。
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu xué zhě rèn wéi tā zài zhēng tǎo qí tā qǐ yì jūn hòu lí kāi cháo tíng guī yǐn shān lín le
sentences.english: Other scholars believe he was killed while campaigning with government troops against other rebel forces after being granted amnesty.
Still other scholars believe he left the court after suppressing the other rebel forces and retired to a secluded life in the mountains.

sentences.pinyin: běi sòng mò nián shè huì pín fù chā jù rì yì lā dà

sentences.simplified: 仅占人口总数不到10%的官僚、地主等特权阶层拥有全国约60%-70%的土地，
sentences.traditional: 僅占人口總數不到10%的官僚、地主等特權階層擁有全國約60%-70%的土地，
sentences.pinyin: jǐn zhàn rén kǒu zǒng shù bú dào 1 3 de guān liáo dì zhǔ děng tè quán jiē céng yōng yǒu quán guó yuē 2 4 2 3 de tǔ dì
sentences.english: In the late Northern Song period, the gap between the rich and the poor in society became increasingly wide.

sentences.simplified: 他们通过各种手段将税收转嫁给失地农民，导致农民生活艰难。
sentences.traditional: 他們通過各種手段將稅收轉嫁給失地農民，導致農民生活艱難。
sentences.pinyin: tā men tōng guò gè zhǒng shǒu duàn jiāng shuì shōu zhuǎn jià gěi shī dì nóng mín dǎo zhì nóng mín shēng huó jiān nán
sentences.english: The privileged classes of officials and landowners, who made up less than 10% of the population, owned about 60–70% of the land nationwide.

sentences.simplified: 另一方面，皇帝纵容官员腐败，加剧了底层农民的生存困境。
sentences.traditional: 另一方面，皇帝縱容官員腐敗，加劇了底層農民的生存困境。
sentences.pinyin: lìng yì fāng miàn huáng dì zòng róng guān yuán fǔ bài jiā jù le dǐ céng nóng mín de shēng cún kùn jìng
sentences.english: They shifted the burden of taxation onto dispossessed peasants through various means, making peasant life extremely difficult.

sentences.simplified: 种种压力之下，农民们选择了反抗，追求新的希望。
sentences.traditional: 種種壓力之下，農民們選擇了反抗，追求新的希望。

sentences.english: Meanwhile, the emperor indulged official corruption, exacerbating the difficulties faced by lower-class peasants in just surviving.
Under such heavy pressure, the peasants chose to rebel in search of new hope.

sentence_translations: The Liangshan Uprising: The Real-life World of Water Margin
When it comes to Chinese classical novels, ..
.. people are most familiar with “Journey to the West”, “Romance of the Three Kingdoms”, and “Dream of the Red Chamber”.
However, in fact, there is a saying in China that there are “Four Great Classical Novels”.
These “Four Great Classical Novels” are four outstanding classical full-length novels.
They represent the highest achievements of the art of the classical Chinese novel.
In addition to the three mentioned above, there is also ”Water Margin“.
“Water Margin” was completed in the early Ming dynasty, and the mainstream view in modern academia is that its author was Shi Nai’an.
This novel depicts the epic tale of the 108 heroes of Liangshan, led by Song Jiang, ..
.. as they rebel against the court, expand their ranks, and eventually accept the court’s amnesty, ..
.. in addition to their battles for the Song dynasty after accepting the amnesty.
The theme expressed is loyalty and righteousness.
The plot of “Water Margin” is vivid and intricate, with sharp dramatic conflicts and well-rounded, three-dimensional characters.
Its literary value is extremely high.
Although the novel contains some mythical elements, such as casting the 108 Liangshan heroes as reincarnations of stars, ..
.. in essence, most of these heroes are common people from the lower and middle strata of society, and the story portrays real social life.
The novel depicts a society of political corruption and moral decay.
Against this backdrop, the Liangshan heroes who rose against the imperial court are not depicted as villains, ..
..  but rather righteous heroes who rob the rich to help the poor.
“Water Margin” is quite bloody and violent compared to the rest of the “Four Great Classical Novels”.
However, its depiction of official corruption and the suffering of the people ..
.. truthfully reflects social conditions at the end of ancient Chinese dynasties ..
.. because it was adapted from a real peasant uprising at the end of the Northern Song dynasty.
At the end of the Northern Song dynasty, a peasant uprising broke out in the Liangshan area of Shandong.
At the time, the Yellow River burst its banks, flooding the land.
The farmers, with no grain to eat, had to catch fish and dig up lotus roots to survive.
However, the court not only failed to distribute grain to provide relief, ..
.. but it also demanded that farmers pay taxes on fish and lotus root.
As a result, local peasants, under the leadership of the low-ranking official Song Jiang, rose up in rebellion against the court.
Although the rebel force numbered only a few thousand, it still had a noticeable impact on society at the time.
Three years later, Song Jiang was defeated and captured, and the rebel army accepted the imperial court’s offer of amnesty.
There is no clear historical record of Song Jiang’s fate.
Some scholars believe he was killed by the court when he was defeated.
Other scholars believe he was killed while campaigning with government troops against other rebel forces after being granted amnesty.
Still other scholars believe he left the court after suppressing the other rebel forces and retired to a secluded life in the mountains.
The Song Jiang uprising was a microcosm of peasant rebellions against the imperial court in the late Northern Song period.
In the late Northern Song period, the gap between the rich and the poor in society became increasingly wide.
The privileged classes of officials and landowners, who made up less than 10% of the population, owned about 60–70% of the land nationwide.
They shifted the burden of taxation onto dispossessed peasants through various means, making peasant life extremely difficult.
Meanwhile, the emperor indulged official corruption, exacerbating the difficulties faced by lower-class peasants in just surviving.
Under such heavy pressure, the peasants chose to rebel in search of new hope.
The real world of “Water Margin” was perhaps not as idealized as depicted in the novel, ..
.. but the historical pattern of “official oppression leading to popular rebellion” reflects a truth:
Whether in the late Northern Song or the final years of other dynasties, the suffering of the common people was deeply etched in memory.
